frames.gloss: 发现[某人/某物]正处于[某动作/某状态]
frames.pattern_notes:
find 后接宾语再加 V-ing（进行中动作）或 V-ed（被动完成状态）作宾语补足语，整存整取为『发现…处于某状态』。
误读点：学习者易把 V-ed 误当作主要谓语（he found his nest occupied 读成『他的巢被发现』），或把 find 与补语拆成两个独立事件。

examples.s: Kim: Well, I found my sister looking through my things yesterday.
The king watched all day as many people complained about the stone, but he found nobody making an attempt to move it.
But when Buck finished his ration and returned, he found his nest occupied.

frames.gloss: 一些[人/物]…，另一些则…（承前省略并列）
frames.pattern_notes:
some 与 others 对举分述同类对象，others 后常省去与前句相同的谓语（and others many more = and others needed many more），须回指前文复原。
误读点：省略谓语后 others 后只剩碎片，学习者易读不通或误把 others 当形容词修饰后面成分。

examples.s: Some people, for example, needed far fewer than 10,000 hours, and others many more.

The spiders were terrible, huge hairy things inches across, or small but deadly black things hiding in the toilet; some lived in vast wheeling webs hanging between trees, some rocked inside webs in the grass, others dived into little holes in the ground complete with lids which shut after them.
And there were many other lizards, smaller but some no less frightening, with swollen, bright-blue tongues.

frames.frame: [前置介词短语(方位/伴随)] + are/is + [真正主语]
frames.gloss: 在[某处]/连同[某物]的是[新信息主语]（完全倒装）
frames.pattern_notes:
介词短语（behind…/along with…）提至句首，be 动词紧随其后，真正主语（通常是新信息）后置。
误读点：学习者易把前置短语里的名词当主语，读到 are/is 时卡壳，或错判后面主语的单复数呼应。

examples.s: Behind each door you open are chances to learn new things, and you have the ability to make your own choices.
Along with these drawings are notes describing his work.

frames.gloss: 并非所有[A]都…（部分否定，= only some）
frames.pattern_notes:
not 直接置于 all/everyone/everything 前构成部分否定，谓语仍用肯定形式。
误读点：学习者易读成全否定『全都不…』，或与 not 在句中漂移的 all…not 混淆；本批另有一例前后对照（not all… but all…）可见其对举用法。

examples.s: Not everyone knows what they want to be.
While not all farm-to-table restaurants are part of the slow food movement, all slow food restaurants are essentially farm-to-table.

frames.frame: [主句(常含否定/条件)] + unless + [条件句]
frames.pattern_notes:
unless = if…not，引导的是主句成立所必需的前提条件，常与 can't/will/would 等情态呼应。
误读点：方向感易读反——学习者易把 unless 后内容当成结果而非条件，与『只要…就』混淆。

examples.s: " Even if you learn something well, you will forget it unless you use it.
Well, the brothers kept everything for themselves and told the emperor that people couldn't see the clothes unless they were clever.

frames.gloss: 以便[做某事]；so as not to 则是『以免[做某事]』
frames.pattern_notes:
固定连接词 so as to 后接动词原形表目的，其否定形式 so as not to 为不可拆的整体。
误读点：学习者易把 so 与 as 拆开误读成『如此…作为』；漏读 not 会把『以免』反向读成『为了』。

examples.s: → In space, astronauts collect all dirty water so as to recycle it for later use.
What do they do so as not to float around while they sleep?

frames.gloss: 一来…，二来…（成对列举理由）
frames.pattern_notes:
成对话语标记，分列两条平行理由，第二个分句常承前省略主干。
误读点：单看 For another 会误读成『为了另一个』，须识别它是 For one thing 的呼应下文。注：本批两例均只出现 For another 半边（教材上下文承接前句 For one thing）。

examples.s: For another, it could be used to grow human organs or tissue in animals, which could be used for human organ transplants or medical treatments.
For another, almost anyone can play baseball, even if you do not have great skills or ability.

frames.gloss: [某类东西]的数量是[B]（中心词 number 为单数）
frames.pattern_notes:
主语中心词是 the number（单数），后接 of 复数名词仍配单数谓语；与 a number of + 复数谓语（许多…）形成查表对比。
误读点：就近的复数名词吸引学习者误配 are；语义上也易把 the number of X 误读成『那些X』。

examples.s: The number of problems from tourists is endless: walking in large groups without considering others who need to walk by, crossing roads without thinking of local traffic laws, and many more.
Thousands of people are missing and the number of deaths is expected to grow.

frames.frame: How long did it take (for) [A] to [V]
frames.pattern_notes:
清单『It takes sb time to』的疑问式/无人称变体：it 为形式主语，sb 可换成 for+NP 引出的事件主语。
误读点：疑问句里 it 无实义、take 的宾语是疑问词，学习者易把 take 误读为『拿』，或把 for half of the city centre 误读成目的状语。

examples.s: How long did it take for half of the city centre to burn?
How long did it take the general to find the happy man?

candidates.note: not just any [NP]：『不是一个随便的…』强调非任意。误读判据很强（易读成『不只是任何猴子』），但仅 1 例，未达 2 句重复线。

example.s: The Monkey King is not just any normal monkey.

candidates.note: nothing but [A]：『只有/不过是[A]』。固定虚词骨架、误读强，仅 1 例。

example.s: Everywhere survivors looked, there was nothing but ruins.

candidates.note: nowhere near [adj]：『远达不到[A]』。误读判据强，仅 1 例。同句的 Everywhere survivors looked（无论往哪看）自由关系副词小句也值得后续关注。

example.s: Organic farming is nowhere near able to meet that need.

candidates.note: There is no doubt that [A]：话语标记框架，『毫无疑问』。仅 1 例。

example.s: There is no doubt that these activities will leave you with unforgettable memories.

candidates.note: thanks to [NP]：『多亏/由于[A]』，褒贬两用。仅 1 例。

example.s: Australian Aboriginal rock art is among the most highly prizing in the world, thanks to its age, detail, freshness, and range of colour.

candidates.note: the moment [clause]：『一…就…』。可能是清单『the minute/way 零关系从句』的新变体（moment 替 minute），仅 1 例。

example.s: The moment Gary looked at it more closely, however, he said he did not like it.

candidates.note: It is not unusual for [A] to [V]：双重否定曲言『并不少见』。误读点在 not unusual 需整体取反，仅 1 例。

example.s: infection multiple decrease severe transform proof blame substantial It is not unusual for an athlete to be well-known while he is active, and quickly forgotten when his athletic career is over.

candidates.note: not [A], but [B]：先否后肯对照框架，与清单『[A], (but) not [B]』语序相反。仅 1 例。

example.s: From this, he concluded that the problem in China was not physical illness, but the spiritual illness of people at that time.

candidates.note: with + [NP] + [V-ing] 独立主格伴随状语：误读点在 with 后的 NP 与 V-ing 是主谓关系而非介词宾语修饰。仅 1 例。

example.s: Edmonton is freezing cold in winter, with daily temperatures averaging -10˚C.

candidates.note: not only… but even…：清单『not only…but also』的变体（but even 递进）。仅 1 例，暂不单独立框架。

example.s: Adventure travel has become more and more popular, not only among the youth but even among the middle-aged.

candidates.note: It is (adj) to [V]：形式主语+不定式，与清单『It is adj that』是否算同族变体拿不准（本批另有 S07891 it is important to remember that），骨架判据成立但接近语法规则范畴。

example.s: Michael Jordan believes that it is important to help others.

candidates.note: [NP] + [V-ed] + (with/by…) 后置过去分词修饰：S05732（pancake rolls stuffed with…）、S07691（steamed fish head covered with chillies）两例重复，但疑为纯语法范畴（分词后置定语）而非查表框架，拿不准骨架判据。

example.s: Why do so many people love steamed fish head covered with chillies?
